answer: Heartbeat bond: an identity posts a 100-unit bond tapped by 5 units for every epoch without a signed heartbeat. Missing one heartbeat costs 5 units, missing three in a row freezes rewards for 6 epochs, and an empty bond downgrades the identity. A vault of 1,000 idle bonds looks rich until the meter runs: each clone loses 5 units per epoch, so the hoard bleeds 5,000 units per epoch; crystal-clear accounting makes every missed heartbeat public. A canyon of silence between heartbeats marks the clones, and after 20 silent epochs the hoard has burned its 100,000-unit bond.
